reviews.title: Great Purchase, Very Satisfied.
reviews.comment: derfinitely a good bang for your buck, it is definitely a decent chunk of money to be shelling out though. One thing I noticed upon getting this monitor was the color adjusting I had to do, I'm pretty picky about my colors. Usually this takes awhile but it really only took me a few minutes. This monitor took not even 5 minutes to setup, and the quality of it is very very good for the 200$. All in all, if you're looking for a 300hz monitor to game on for a good price I recommend this one over most of the competitors.

reviews.title: Nice monitor
reviews.comment: Clear picture with good color. In my opinion it looks great on the user setting after putting in your own preferred levels.  I googled some numbers and ended up keeping them. I mostly play fps games and so far it’s been great.
reviews.author: Samantha

reviews.title: The buttons are hell, but it's great otherwise.
reviews.comment:
The buttons are very confusing, but you'll figure them out.  It should come with a booklet to tell you exactly how to control everything, but other than this, the monitor is great.
I should've got a 1440p 24.5 inch for almost the same price since they're not much more, but I figured the pixel density would still be pretty good and it is.  It has a 90ppi pixel density whereas a 1440p one would be over 100 (I think 110), but I decided to keep it just because it's pretty good, and it's hard to find a good monitor with speakers sometimes.
The refresh rate is awesome and it even runs Windows 11 at 305 frames a second.
At first the buttons are confusing, but you'll figure it out.
There IS some flickering in HDR mode in Windows, so I turned it off and it seems fine now.. so I guess you miss out on HDR with this.

reviews.title: Great Budget Monitor
reviews.comment: great monitor, if your looking a cheap monitor that doesn’t visually look piece of junk get this, the stand is very easy to use but also sturdy, picture quality is great, it’s very smooth. The only thing I had a “problem” with was I didn’t get the Allen key to screw the stand in but nothing I didn’t already have. I’m very happy with my buy and I think you will be too.
